::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 26 1866  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55386 (2) P. 520
:::

Dear Miss Yonge,                                                                   Oct 26 1866

[Mr Williams](people/person_1964.qmd) of [W. &amp; Norgate](organizations/other_165.qmd) tells me that reserved rights which are made [illegible]  [illegible]  [illegible]  are for twelve months after publication cease to exist and [illegible]  [illegible] copyright treaty was only made in 1853 so you are quite safe in all aspects.

I shall be very glad to hear the results of your consultation with [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd), and hope very much that something really valuable can come of your [Extracts](other_books/otherbook_71.qmd). I should be rather glad to have a sketch of the whole scheme and a bit of the extracts when you have leisure [&lt;i&gt;sic&lt;/i&gt;].

Also Pr[illegible] look with interest for [illegible]  parents, [illegible]

Very faithfully yours

[Alex. Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

&nbsp;
